data.reservation_custom_field_residual_risk_a: I accept reservation custom-field write risk

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll for listing updates. Minimum 1 minute.
data_description.reservation_scan_interval: How often to poll for reservation updates. Minimum 1 minute.
data_description.custom_field_definitions_scan_interval: How often to refresh custom field definitions. Minimum 1 minute.
data_description.filter_cancelled: When enabled, cancelled, declined, and expired reservations are excluded from sensor state and attributes.
data_description.custom_field_write_account_id: Writes remain disabled unless this ID matches the accountId reported by Hostaway custom-field definitions for this entry.
data_description.listing_custom_field_writes_enabled: Allow partial listing PUT requests that send the complete merged customFieldValues array for this verified account.
data_description.reservation_custom_field_writes_enabled: Allow reservation custom-field PUT requests for this verified account. Every write is followed by mandatory read-back verification.
data_description.reservation_custom_field_residual_risk_a: Required for reservation writes. Hostaway has a known bug where reservation custom-field updates can report success without persisting; read-back detects this, but reservation write semantics remain unconfirmed.

data_description.rate_limit_budget: How many requests per 10 seconds this integration allows itself. The default of 180 is a deliberate safety margin chosen by this integration, not a Hostaway value: Hostaway refuses requests above 200 per 10 seconds, and the margin leaves room for other clients sharing the account or IP address. Accepts 1 to 200.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Scan intervals must be at least 1 minute each.
error.missing_write_account_id: Enter the Hostaway account ID before enabling custom-field writes.
error.reservation_risk_not_accepted: Reservation custom-field writes require accepting the documented residual risk.
error.invalid_rate_limit_budget: Rate limit budget must be a whole number between 1 and 200
